detailed_descriptions.en: Explore a vibrant town where something new happens every day. Get to know cute characters, find cozy places and interesting locations, collect resources in nature, or just take a walk and see what’s going on around town. The combination of variable weather, seasons, and a full day-night cycle makes every day in PAO PAO special. Turn a small kitchen into the restaurant of your dreams. Install equipment, put a menu together, and serve guests of all kinds, from a few simple orders to a dining room full of hungry customers. Play solo or co-op with up to 3 other players to run the kitchen and help the restaurant grow and flourish. Beyond the restaurant walls, a bustling world awaits. Grow your own crops, fish from the shore or a boat, collect resources in the forest, walk around town, or spend an afternoon in the arcade. When work is over, there’s always something fun to do. Make PAO PAO your home! Bring your vision to life, change it any time, and decorate your house, restaurant, and garden just the way you like them. Combine furniture, decor, and various styles to create a truly cozy space. PAO PAO is even more fun with friends! Work together in the kitchen, split up to explore various parts of the town, or skip the work altogether and go wild. Organize boat races, play basketball, shoot each other with water guns, and turn an ordinary day into your own little adventure.
